title: Creating Security Records

children:
The SCALE window security system is extremely flexible and can support 
 all environments. A relaxed security 
 system will allow all employees to access and perform all actions 
 on every window. You can then restrict user permissions as security problems 
 arise. On the other hand, a            highly-restrictive 
 security system will allow only select employees access to certain 
 windows. You can then grant user permissions as needed. The system is not shipped with any default security settings, so you will need to create 
 your own security records to take advantage of the security system. If you do not create any security records, all users will be able to access 
 and perform actions on any SCALE window. There are three 
 types of security records: user-level, group 
 and        system-level.   If there is security set up for a user, it must be honored over any security set up for a group to which that user belongs.  So in other words, the hierarchy for checking security is user, then group, then system.

You can create user security records on the Security Permissions Window.  When an employee attempts to access a SCALE window, the system will determine if he/she 
 has any user-level security records. If an employee has a user-level record, 
 the system will apply that record each time the employee attempts to access the window. User-level security  limits a 
 single employee's ability to access and/or perform actions on a specific 
 window.

Group level security allows you to establish a group of users who are all assigned the same security. This security level is setup using the 'Security Group' Window. Group-level security is especially helpful if your employees work in departments and only need to access particular 
 windows. For example, you could restrict a packing employee's access to 
 Labor Management, which is a supervisor-level 
 window. Users can be added or removed from the group. Any security settings for a group can be changed and all users in the group automatically reflect the new settings. A security "group" can be assigned on the User Profile or Security Permissions windows.

System-level security limits all employees' ability to access 
 and/or perform actions on a specific window. One system-level security 
 record will apply to all users. System-level security is especially helpful 
 if you want to ensure that critical records, such as status flows, are 
 not deleted or modified.

If the employee does not have a specific user level record 
 for a window that he/she wants to access, the system will look for a group level security record. If a
level security record exists, then it applies the
level security. The system level security record is applied if both user and group level security records
The system will still allow all users access to that window if a system level record is not created for a window.

Before you start creating security records, decide whether you want 
 a system with highly-restrictive security or a minimum-security system 
 that is restrictive when needed:

Relaxed Security:  This security strategy allows all employees 
 to access and perform all actions on all windows. You can then set more 
 restrictive security for particular users, as needed. You can implement 
 this type of strategy by a creating system-level record that allows permission 
 to perform all actions on a window. Then, you will create specific restrictive 
 records for the appropriate employees.

Restrictive:  This security strategy allows only 
 select employees access to certain windows. You can then grant user permissions 
 to perform actions as needed. You can implement this type of strategy 
 by creating user-level or group level record(s) that allow the appropriate window permissions.

In order to address the security settings on RF processing, 
 adjust the settings on the following areas of the security window:

The options in this area determine what actions a user can perform during 
 various RF processing sessions:

The options in this area determine what RF process(es) a user will have 
 access to from the RF Main Menu:

The options in this area determine if a user will be allowed to change 
 their password during an RF session.

The options in this area determine what 
 fields that appear on the receipt information entry window when processing 
 blind receipts on an RF device.

In order to address the security settings on Warehouse Mobile application, 
 adjust the settings on the following areas of the security window.

Warehouse Mobile work execution actions in Form Specific section

Full Option - Select to get to perform all actions for the replenishment work for the user. This access is validated by the security check point and is made available to user only if user has the required permission. This option is not available if the user has not entered any quantity.

        System-level security limits all employees' ability to access

The system level security record is applied if both user and group level security records do not exist.  The system will still allow all users access to that window if a system level record is not created for a window.
         
         
        Security Decisions: Relaxed vs. Highly-Restrictive...
        Before you start creating security records, decide whether you want 
 a system with highly-restrictive security or a minimum-security system 
 that is restrictive when needed:

 to access and perform all actions on all windows. You can then set more

        Security And RF Processing...
        In order to address the security settings on RF processing, 
 adjust the settings on the following areas of the security window:
         
        
            
            
            
                
                    SECURITY WINDOW AREA
                     
                
                
                    RF SECURITY OPTIONS
                     
                
            
            
                
                    Work Confirmation
                
                
                    The options in this area determine what actions a user can perform during 
 various RF processing sessions:
                    - Allow Dock Management Bypass
                    - Allow New Container 
                    - Allow Pass
                    - Allow Short Pick
                    - Allow Skip
                    - Bypass
                    - Override Location
                     
                
            
            
                
                    RF Main Menu
                
                
                    The options in this area determine what RF process(es) a user will have 
 access to from the RF Main Menu:
                    - Cycle Count Reconcile
                    - Dock Management
                    - Inventory Management
                    - Location Inquiry
                    - Receipt Container Nesting
                    - Receiving
                    - Shipping Container Nesting
                    - Work
                     
                
            
            
                
                    RF Change Password
                
                
                    The options in this area determine if a user will be allowed to change 
 their password during an RF session.
                     
                
            
            
                
                    Blind Receipt RF Header Fields
                     
                
                
                    The options in this area determine what 
 fields that appear on the receipt information entry window when processing 
 blind receipts on an RF device.
                     
                
            
        
         
         
        Security And Warehouse Mobile 
         
        In order to address the security settings on Warehouse Mobile application, 
 adjust the settings on the following areas of the security window.
         
        Run - selection of this security permission is mandatory for application to process work.
         
        Warehouse Mobile work execution actions in Form Specific section
        
            Full
            Over Pick
            Partial pick
            Pass
            Short pick
            Skip
        
        Full Option - Select to get to perform all actions for the replenishment work for the user. This access is validated by the security check point and is made available to user only if user has the required permission. This option is not available if the user has not entered any quantity. 
        Exit Point security 
         
        The following security options need to be selected to configure exit points.
         
        Under General section
        
            New
            Delete
